newsitem.title: UK: UK Treasury welcomes strong housing starts data.
newsitem.headline: UK Treasury welcomes strong housing starts data.

text.p: The UK Treasury said the rise in November housing starts, completions and sales showed an all round improvement in the housing market and were a good start to 1997.
"Forty percent more new homes are going up now than this time last year. This shows we are building on the economy's firm foundations," said economic secretary Angela Knight.
The Department of Environment said housing starts rose 15 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis in the three months to November while total completions were up 1.0 percent.
